answer: Sybils splitting into a nebula of fake identities still need distinct bonded stake plus independent attestations, so forgery cost scales with identity count rather than collapsing to zero. Each agent stakes a bond on its own island of reputation, and every epoch peers must co-sign a liveness pulse. One identity, one pulse, one bond: faking a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, making mass deception economically irrational. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
